title: Attendance Check-In Export Gap
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`faith:rosary`), retreat events (`faith:retreat`), attendance logs (`faith:attendance`), fasting journals (`faith:fast`), practice reviews (`faith:ops`).
app: Spiritual-practice telemetry — rosary counters, meditation-retreat schedules, church-attendance logs, and fasting journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=faith:attendance source_name=* source_event_epoch=* export_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((export_epoch-source_event_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by source_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures attendance export lag by data source for attendance feeds.
value: Lag tracking shows which data source create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside attendance feeds.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `attendance export lag` on `faith:attendance` events and aggregate them by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of data source with average and worst attendance export lag.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how long things take for each data source so you can see where attendance feeds slows down.
